hard_case: the expected value is a test-local `const want = 30`, which the spec graded relational_check / weak before RIPR-SPEC-0247 rule 2 read a literal `const` (2026-10-14)

truth.toolchain: node 22.22.0; tsx 4.23.15; node:test + node:assert (built in); edit applied by hand and the test command run on the whole package

mutants.failing_test: grace fee is three per day
mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: 10 days give 40 instead of 30

reasoning: The test declares `const want = 30` and asserts `t.assert.equal(graceFee(10), want)`; the edit makes the fee `days * 4`, so 40 is compared with 30 and the test fails. RIPR-SPEC-0247 rule 2 (amended 2026-10-14) reads a test-local `const` bound to a literal coercion cannot reach as that literal, so the assertion is exact_value / strong and the finding reads `credited`. Before the amendment the variable read relational_check / weak and the row was a false actionable gap.
